mentions.name: Gnunae (그네)
mentions.description: An Electron-based AI web browser with full user control, connecting PlayWright MCP to a local Codex LLM backend. It requires a ChatGPT Pro+ subscription (since Codex has no usage fee unlike API keys) and lets users pick models: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max handles complex web tasks without templating the DOM, while Codex-Mini is faster. The browser can execute multi-step web tasks autonomously, such as applying to recruiting sites with no interaction, with a persistent data store (currently disabled in the published version).
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve made AI browser that others do but having full control.
